# Akdeniz Dental Clinic

> Akdeniz Dental Clinic is a dental clinic in Antalya, Turkey, treating international patients (mainly from the UK, Ireland, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Romania and Russian-speaking countries). Treatments include dental implants, All-on-4 and All-on-6 full-arch implants, zirconium crowns, E-max veneers and smile makeovers (Hollywood smile). The clinic works with its own dental laboratory (Akdeniz Dental Lab).

- Address: Çaybaşı, 1358. Sk. Premier Plaza D:1 B Blok, Muratpaşa, 07100 Antalya, Turkey
- Phone / WhatsApp: +90 541 248 35 62
- Email: info@akdenizdental.com
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–19:00 (Turkey time)
- Languages: English, German, Polish, Romanian, Russian
